demo.cliff: the trait family a spacecraft does not set for you
teaches: scale: spacecraft is what puts a weapon on the ship damage track instead of the personal one.
power is the draw the ship's plant has to cover before this will fire.
range.band on a ship weapon is the band the mount reaches, and value stays null because the number is not in metres.
demo.trap: family is written as shipWeapon on every trait here, deliberately. A spacecraft does NOT override the trait family — it is left at species — so a ship weapon whose traits are typed by hand under the default family resolves to nothing, silently, and the ship scans as armed.

system.description: A single-emitter turret laser off a yard on Bellweather. Cheap, and it holds its focus.
